note: The harness-shape gate’s exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-harness.ts reads it; nothing generates from it). An entry excuses one skill’s description and body findings — the "Use when" trigger and "Not for" boundary, the gap, the numbered steps and the closing "Done means" list — and never a missing SKILL.md, name or description. The list ships empty: the skills written before the skill shape was gated have all been reshaped to it (the migration's P4b). A new entry needs a reason, an owner and a date, and the gate fails an entry that excuses nothing. An entry is { name, match, reason, owner, since }: match is an exact path or a whole-path glob. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-harness.
